title: Build separate admin authentication system with username/password login

requirements.text: Create backend admin authentication system in main.mo with stable variable for storing admin credentials (username and hashed password), and actor methods for admin login verification that returns a session token or admin principal identifier upon successful authentication

quotes: Backend actor methods for admin authentication using username/password credentials
Secure credential storage in backend canister

acceptanceCriteria: Stable variable stores admin credentials with hashed passwords
Login method accepts username and password and returns authentication result
Password verification uses secure hashing comparison
Failed login attempts return error messages without exposing security details

requirements.text: Implement role-based access control in backend by adding admin role type to user profile data structure and creating guard methods that verify admin status before allowing access to admin-only operations

quotes: Admin role type in backend to distinguish admin users from regular users
Permission checks on all admin-only operations

acceptanceCriteria: User profile includes role field (user or admin)
Backend methods verify admin role before executing privileged operations
Non-admin users receive authorization errors when attempting admin actions

requirements.text: Create AdminLogin.tsx page component with form containing username and password input fields, login button, form validation, and error message display that authenticates against the backend admin authentication system

quotes: Admin login page separate from user Internet Identity login

acceptanceCriteria: Login form includes username and password fields with proper validation
Submit button calls backend admin login method
Successful login redirects to admin dashboard
Failed login displays error message without page reload
Form prevents submission with empty fields

requirements.text: Implement frontend admin session management using React Context or local storage to persist admin authentication state, storing admin session token or identifier after successful login and clearing it on logout
acceptanceCriteria: Admin authentication state persists across page refreshes
Session token is stored securely in browser storage
Logout clears admin session data completely
Expired sessions redirect to admin login page

requirements.text: Create protected route wrapper component for admin routes that checks admin authentication status and redirects unauthenticated users to the admin login page before allowing access to admin dashboard and admin management pages

quotes: Admin-only routes and components in frontend
Protected routes that require admin authentication

acceptanceCriteria: All admin routes require authentication before rendering
Unauthenticated access attempts redirect to admin login
Authenticated admin users can access all admin pages
Route protection works consistently across all admin paths

requirements.text: Update AdminPanel.tsx to display admin profile information (logged-in username, role) in the header section and add logout button that clears admin session and redirects to admin login page

quotes: Admin profile display showing logged-in admin details

acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard header shows current admin username
Logout button is visible and accessible in admin panel
Clicking logout clears session and returns to login page
Admin role is displayed if multiple admin types exist

requirements.text: Add admin login route to App.tsx routing configuration at path /admin/login that renders the AdminLogin component and is accessible without authentication

quotes: Admin login page separate from user Internet Identity login

acceptanceCriteria: Route /admin/login renders AdminLogin component
Admin login page is accessible without authentication
Route does not conflict with existing admin routes
Successful login redirects to /admin path

constraints: Use single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo for all admin authentication logic
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication system for regular users
Admin authentication must be completely separate from user Internet Identity flow
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts
Password storage must use secure hashing, never plain text
nonGoals: Backend integration for Payouts, Expenses, Trading Overview modules
Password reset or forgot password functionality
